title: Getting Dressed for School
text: Hi! My name is Leo. Every morning, I wear a shirt and pants to school. Today it is cold, so I put on a jacket and gloves too. My sister likes to wear a dress and a hat. She also has a red bag for her books. After school, we take off our shoes at home.

questions.question: What does Leo wear to school every morning?
questions.source_sentence: Every morning, I wear a shirt and pants to school.

questions.question: What does Leo put on because it is cold?
questions.source_sentence: Today it is cold, so I put on a jacket and gloves too.

questions.question: What color is Leo's sister's bag?
questions.source_sentence: She also has a red bag for her books.
